name: Agentic Test-Driven Development
outcome: Use tests to guide and verify agent-assisted implementation.
description: Apply test-driven development to agent-assisted software changes. Translate requirements into tests, review test coverage and guide the agent through a test-first implementation and refactoring cycle.
external: Programming, Git and basic software testing, including running and interpreting unit tests.
prior: Ability to run and interpret unit tests
learn: Design independently reviewed tests from scientific requirements
Use deterministic fixtures and a repeatable test command
tools: Your chosen CLI (Claude Code or Codex)
moduleDescriptions: Convert a scientific requirement into a failing test with expected values.
Use fixed fixtures, isolated state and one repeatable test command.
Direct the agent to implement only enough code to pass; then refactor.
Inspect tests and changes for weakened assertions, over-mocking and numerical regressions.
practice: Add a small scientific function using a test-first workflow.
acceptance: A reviewed failing test precedes implementation; deterministic regression tests pass without weakened assertions.
prerequisiteRationale: One CLI course supplies agent operation; test-first design is taught here.
